Each clip is one Bible verse that was cut automatically from a full chapter recording. Listen to the whole clip while reading the transcript, and decide whether the words you hear match the words that are written.

Only whole words count. Because the clips were cut automatically, many start or end with a tiny piece of sound from the previous or next verse (a breath, a click, or part of a syllable), or the very end of the last word is slightly clipped. That is fine: if you can hear and recognise every word of the transcript, and you do not hear any other complete word, choose No missing or extra words (exact match).

  • EXTRA: you hear at least one whole word that is not in the transcript (for example a word from the previous or next verse, or a chapter number or section title read aloud).
  • MISSING: at least one word of the transcript is not spoken, or is cut off so much that you cannot recognise it.

Please ignore voice quality, accent, speed, breaths and background noise. Punctuation is not spoken, and numbers written as digits may be read out as words; neither counts as a mismatch.

If you choose one of the last three options, please also say where the problem is (required) and, if you can, write the extra or missing words (optional).
